answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can trade, and publish a signed history of its deals. Peers then check every newcomer like a comet crossing a shared ocean of records: one identity, one stake, one trail. If two names mirror the same stake or the same signed history, both are frozen and the stake is slashed. Faking a hundred agents means paying a hundred stakes, while an honest agent pays once and keeps trading.
